question: A shopkeeper usually makes a large gram flour laddu (circular in shape) of radius 9 cm. How many gram flour laddus of radius 3 cm can be made from this big gram flour laddu? (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Radius 9 cm.

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = 4/3 πr³ 

**Calculation: **

So the number of flour laddus will be n

As per the question

⇒ 4/3 × π × 9 × 9 × 9 = n × 4/3 × π × 3 × 3 × 3

⇒ n = 27

**∴ The correct option is 1**
